Frequently asked questions

Questions About Fencing

How do I request a fencing quote?

Call or WhatsApp 067 534 8511. Include your area, the type of fencing you need and any useful site measurements or photographs.

What types of fencing do you offer?

This website lists razor wire fencing, electric fencing and perimeter security solutions. Contact us to confirm availability for your project.

Can I get fencing for my home or business?

Contact us with details about your property and requirements to discuss a suitable solution.

Where do you provide services?

Contact us to confirm whether your location falls within our service area.
